prerequisite: A SUPPORTED real child-run observation source EXISTS, verified live against the Meadow chat broker: omp child runs register in sessions.list with their own instanceId/sessionId/generation and locator.sessionFile nested inside the parent session's .jsonl directory (.../<parent>.jsonl/<Child>.jsonl; the child JSONL's session header names parentSession). Verified by querying the live broker directly (the authoring agent is itself a child run and appears there) and by reading real child session files. Registration proves identity + LIVENESS only. The broker carries NO exit/verdict channel — a child that finishes, fails, or is cancelled simply deregisters, so absence proves nothing (Unknown) and verdicts stay Not reported. needs_input is not observable (child runs register interactions:false). No paneId on child registrations, so no pane link is guessed. No grandchild exists on disk yet; the linker derives descendant depth from the path structure.

data_reality: The transcript proves spawn identity + acknowledgment (structured task-call arguments + paired results). The live broker registration adds identity + liveness — and NOTHING else: no exit state, no failure flag, no verdict, no assignment for broker-only children (honestly rendered as unobservable). Runtime state (Running) and result verdict (Not reported) remain separate axes.
